integrity: Proof and standalone tests were checked in this package; finite tests use no third-party dependencies. Residual possibility of an unindexed equivalent result. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Forward directed cycles; exactly four initial binary grains at {0,1,d,d+1}; d>=3, n>=2d+3. The n=2d+2 comparison determines only Euler characteristic. The triangulated torus T_{n,1,d} is known from earlier work; the new step is the explicit collapse from its three-dimensional avalanche parent. Finite verification is not a universal proof.
title: A torus phase for two-pair avalanches on directed cycles
